Class DrawBufferManager.BufferSubAllocator

java.lang.Object
icyllis.arc3d.granite.DrawBufferManager.BufferSubAllocator
Enclosing class:
DrawBufferManager
public final class DrawBufferManager.BufferSubAllocator extends Object
This instance can have only one owner at the same time. When one owner finished using it, call reset() then clear the reference to this object, and the ownership will be transferred to the manager.

    • getMappedSubrange

      public long getMappedSubrange(int count, int stride, int align, @NonNull BufferBindInfo outInfo)
      Return a host coherent memory address, if NULL then allocation is failed

      The stride is the size of vertex, instance, uniform block, or shader storage block. If either is an array of structs, it can also be the size of that struct. In both cases, the stride should already be aligned base on block/struct alignment rules.

      Parameters:
      count - the minimum number of blocks/structs to reserve
      stride - the size of block/struct
      align - the alignment requirement
      outInfo - the out buffer bind info
      Returns:
      a mapped, write-only address, or NULL if failed

    • appendMappedWithStride

      public long appendMappedWithStride(int count)
      Returns a buffer writer for count*stride bytes, where stride was the last value passed to getMappedSubrange.

      If count <= availableWithStride(), then the appended range will be contiguous with the BufferViewInfo returned from the last call to getMappedSubrange (and/or other calls to appendMappedStride). The binding's size should be increased by count*stride, which is the caller's responsibility.

      Otherwise, NULL will be returned and no change is made to the allocator.
